comments: Reassembled from GEO/SRA source for iHBCA v1.0; ontology fields mapped during assembly. Reference genome is GRCh37 (hg19), differing from most other iHBCA studies. Mixed chemistry (v2 HiSeq Batch 1-2, v3 NovaSeq Batch 3-4) with pooled/demultiplexed design in later batches.
description: Single-cell RNA-seq atlas of 86,136 cells from 28 premenopausal donors mapping hormone-regulated cell-cell interaction networks in the human breast.
